cards.scope: Complete the XLM parity and threat model
cards.evidenceText: Design decision: use one Stellar account per vault, funded and activated by the user's wallet through CreateAccount. Connected-wallet support remains to verify. XRC source can represent XLM/USD; its generic defaults include received-rate floor 3 and freshness up to 120 seconds, but live XLM source quorum and quote are unverified. The read-only IC connector refused the backend because its service-discoverability manifest is missing; the direct XRC sample is a paid update and was not called. Direct endpoint probes could not run under the local DNS sandbox. Mara Junior Opus read-only coordination is underway across deposit proof, XRP claim reuse, and release prerequisites; research is not complete. Do not infer oracle readiness or activation. A 2-of-3 independent provider-result quorum is the Horizon target; provider selection is unresolved and pure helpers have no provider wiring. SDF public Horizon, Tatum authenticated Horizon, and Blockdaemon authenticated Horizon are research candidates; Ankr is a fourth candidate. None is validated or provisioned. Separately, a read-only mainnet XRP config check on 2026-10-27 returned Active, a $30,000 debt ceiling (3,000,000,000,000 e8s), and an explicit Linear rate curve. Decoded live values are a 128% borrow threshold, 117% liquidation ratio, 7.5% liquidation bonus, 0.2% borrowing fee, 1.5% base APR, and 132.266666666666666624% recovery target. Those differ from the XRP source constructor's $2,500 ceiling and 150%/133%/12% parameters; do not present constructor values as current live parity. XRP evidence only; no XLM registration, deployment, or live config is proved.

cards.scope: Build the Stellar rail and independent address and transaction vectors
cards.evidenceText: Commit 96c55211 adds source-only account-to-exact-ledger reserve binding. Commit 3e12fba5 reads deterministic `last_modified_ledger` body data for historical reserve observation only, not provider quorum or live deposit credit. Commit ba0dccbf adds a pure 2-of-3 fixed-slot account/reserve quorum helper. Commit 445ebec4 adds pure 2-of-3 transaction-ledger and exact deposit-receipt matching helpers. These helpers are source-only: no independent provider configuration/wiring, live calls, or Cargo verification. Direct provider endpoint probes could not run under local DNS sandbox; candidates remain unvalidated. The last focused `chains::stellar` Cargo suite passed 34/34 and deposit-state migration test passed 1/1 before the latest changes. Current production path still asserts one provider. No actual Horizon outcall or live deposit credit exists. Pending claim/intent records are dormant state only, not a lifecycle. No vault/deposit/claim lifecycle, XLM registration, deployment, or collateral admission is proved.

cards.scope: Add stable state and an XLM launch guard
cards.evidenceText: A source scaffold adds a Frozen NativeXlm config constructor that clones risk/curve fields from a supplied current XRP config, sets XLM to 7 decimals and a 1 XLM minimum, and clears observations. State config tests passed 2/2 and legacy custody decode passed 1/1 before the latest route/reserve-binding changes. Generic update_collateral_config rejects both the canonical XLM key and NativeXlm. Persistent serde-defaulted XlmPendingDeposit state and permanent receipt data exist; prior CBOR round-trip/old-snapshot default test passed 1/1. Commit 445ebec4 adds pure 2-of-3 transaction-ledger matching and exact deposit-receipt helpers, but neither is wired into live processing or Cargo-tested. Claim/intent records remain dormant: they do not drive a live flow, create credit, or prove provider quorum. Config remains Frozen; XLM is not registered, deployed, or admitted as collateral.

cards.scope: Implement verified XLM deposits and borrowing
cards.evidenceText: Earlier source changes added fail-closed guards to generic ICRC entrypoints. Commit 3e12fba5 adds fail-closed handling for XLM borrow, full-liquidation, repay-close, and push-sweep fallback paths; claim/intent records remain dormant only. Read-only deposit-proof coordination is underway and not complete. Cargo tests/build have not rerun after the current source changes. WP3 remains blocked because no XLM deposit/borrow endpoint or live credit lifecycle exists; the current Frozen config and generic update denial keep XLM unreachable. No XLM admission is proved.

cards.scope: Implement XLM claims, exits, and liquidation handling
cards.evidenceText: Commits 6da8cd46 and 3e12fba5 add source-level fail-closed handling for unsupported XLM withdrawal, close, full-liquidation, repay-close, and push-sweep fallback routes; these reject XLM rather than routing it through ICRC. Read-only XRP claim-reuse review is underway and not complete. Claim/intent state remains dormant only. WP4 remains blocked because no supported XLM claim, withdrawal, close, or liquidation payout lifecycle exists. Frozen config and generic update denial prevent XLM admission now. Cargo tests/build have not rerun after the current changes.

cards.scope: Integrate Candid, user flows, and operator monitoring
cards.evidenceText: Candid regeneration passed with `RUMI_REGEN_DID=1 cargo +1.92.0 test --locked -p rumi_protocol_backend --bin rumi_protocol_backend check_candid_interface_compatibility -- --exact --nocapture`; `scripts/regenerate-declarations.sh rumi_protocol_backend` ran, and the non-regeneration compatibility test passed. No XLM vault, deposit, withdrawal, or claim endpoints or user flows are present. Keep interface and lifecycle work in progress.

cards.scope: Validate the rail with tests, independent review, and Stellar testnet evidence
cards.evidenceText: The last focused `chains::stellar` Cargo suite passed 34/34 and deposit-state migration test passed 1/1 before the current changes. Commit 445ebec4 adds pure transaction-ledger and exact deposit-receipt 2-of-3 helpers; Cargo tests/build remain pending, and these helpers have no provider configuration or live wiring. The account transform's deterministic `last_modified_ledger` body value is historical reserve evidence only. Current production code still asserts one provider. Direct endpoint probes were blocked by local DNS sandbox; provider candidates remain unvalidated and no live calls/quorum/credit exist. New unsupported XLM borrow, full-liquidation, repay-close, and push-sweep routes fail closed at source level. Dormant claim/intent state does not provide a lifecycle. Independent review found no confirmed XRP regression, and V2 resume exact-journal continuation is unchanged. No registration, deployment, or collateral admission is proved.

cards.scope: Prepare deployment, configuration, and activation evidence
cards.evidenceText: Read-only release-prerequisite coordination is underway and not complete. Release remains blocked until implementation, exact-head review and CI, artifact verification, audit disposition, rollback and monitoring plans, and current Stellar oracle quorum, reserve, fee, provider, and key checks are evidenced. XRC XLM/USD live quorum is unproven. Deployment and activation remain separate proof points from signing, broadcasting, and moving funds.
